name: atlias-transaction
description: Experimental native tool batches; each operation uses Claude Code's ordinary tool permission path.

enabled.title: Native tool batches
enabled.description: Register a bounded sequential batch tool. Requires native qualification on the installed client.

deferBuiltins.title: Defer built-in tools
deferBuiltins.description: Keep native tools available through ToolSearch while loading the batch tool upfront. Requires ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=true.

deferShell.title: Defer the shells too
deferShell.description: With hotCoreTools, keep only Read, Edit and Write visible and defer Bash and PowerShell behind ToolSearch; a check can still run as a batch operation. Experimental; requires same-model quality qualification.

omitBatch.title: Leave the batch tool out
omitBatch.description: With hotCoreTools, keep the same deferral but do not register the batch tool; every native tool stays callable directly or through ToolSearch. Experimental; requires same-model quality qualification.

hotGlob.title: Keep Glob visible too
hotGlob.description: With hotCoreTools, keep Glob natively visible as well; every other deferred built-in stays deferred. Experimental; requires same-model quality qualification.

hotCoreTools.title: Keep core tools visible
hotCoreTools.description: With deferBuiltins, keep Read, Edit, Write, Bash and PowerShell natively visible and defer only the other available built-ins. Experimental; requires same-model quality qualification.

unchangedReads.title: Pass unchanged-file Read notices
unchangedReads.description: In a batch, pass the exact native notice for a re-read of an unchanged file through as executed instead of stopping with require-native-read. Experimental; requires same-model quality qualification.

deduplicateTextReads.title: Deduplicate text Read results
deduplicateTextReads.description: Keep exact native text and metadata; represent a verified duplicate file.content with a reversible recipe. Experimental; requires same-model quality qualification.
